text:
mina: Heads-up: starting v2 silent rollout for api surface A in us-east in ~4m. Plan: 3% -> 12% -> 30% with 8m holds. Watch auth header failures and schema mismatches.

deploybot: Rollout scheduled id r-us-204, start 6543219890. Initial 3%. Pause if auth_fail >0.8% OR schema_errors >0.5% for 5m.

otto: Quick note - v2 adds an optional `X-Client-Auth-V2` header and legacy clients will ignore it, but should still auth. We added a fallback but theres a path that may drop the original Authorization header in edge-proxy when both headers present.

chandra: Who are high-risk tenants with custom auth flows? I can pin them preemptively.

otto: tenant-payments, tenant-legacy-sso, partner-oldflow.

sre: Canary started at 6543219890. Initial metrics: p95 stable, global errors 0.15%. Monitoring per-tenant auth_fail and schema_errors.

deploybot: Canary progressed to 12% at 6543219902.

sre: Alert: tenant-payments auth_fail spike at 6543219910; hits 2% for that tenant, manifests as 401s downstream. Global auth_fail still 0.4% but localized.

mina: Pause rollout. deploybot, pin tenant-payments and tenant-legacy-sso to v1 and run a deploy-diff for the edge-proxy behavior. Also apply a quick edge toggle to prefer original Authorization header when present.

deploybot: Executing:
```
/deploy pause r-us-204
/deploy pin tenant-payments v1
/deploy pin tenant-legacy-sso v1
/edge toggle prefer-original-auth true --canary
```
Pins and toggle applied; pause at 6543219916.

otto: Repro in logs: when `X-Client-Auth-V2` present, a refactor path cleared `Authorization` before downstream signature check. PR #1982 fixes the clear-path and adds a unit test.

chandra: After pins + toggle, tenant-payments auth failures dropped to baseline. Good.

docs-bot: Draft release note created: "v2 rollout: optional X-Client-Auth-V2 header introduced. Edge-proxy bug could drop Authorization when both headers present causing 401s for some SSO clients. Hotfix applied and affected tenants pinned to v1 during mitigation."

mina: Plan: merge hotfix to canary images (edge-proxy v2.0.4-hotfix), run canary for 10m, then resume staged rollout with an extra pre-check for auth_fail per-tenant. Also follow-up: add a migration note in the upgrade guide.

sre: Will open a postmortem if we find more tenant impact. For now closing thread after canary validation. :white_check_mark:
